about.title: About Mortgage Payoff Calculator - Early Payment Planning Tool
about.description: The Mortgage Payoff Calculator helps homeowners estimate how extra principal payments may change loan duration and total interest. It compares scenarios such as bi-weekly payments, annual lump sums, and monthly extra payments so you can review tradeoffs before making a repayment plan.

steps.description: Review estimated interest differences and timeline changes from extra payments.

steps.title: Plan Payment Strategy
steps.description: Develop a sustainable extra payment plan that fits your budget and goals.

tips: Even small extra payments may reduce total interest over time

faq.q: How do extra mortgage payments affect the loan?
faq.a: Extra payments generally reduce principal faster, which can shorten the loan term and lower total interest. The effect depends on the balance, rate, remaining term, and payment schedule entered into the calculator.

faq.q: Should I pay extra on my mortgage or invest the money?
faq.a: This depends on your mortgage rate, expected investment returns, taxes, liquidity needs, and risk tolerance. Use the calculator to compare scenarios rather than treating one approach as universally better.

faq.q: How can I compare extra payment strategies?
faq.a: Bi-weekly payments and extra monthly principal payments can affect payoff timing in different ways. The right approach depends on your cash flow, preferences, and broader financial priorities.

faq.q: When should I avoid paying extra on my mortgage?
faq.a: Avoid extra payments if you have high-interest debt, lack emergency savings, or can earn significantly higher returns through investments. Also consider if you plan to move soon or need liquidity.
